description: The bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model for various optimizations applied to two models: the NESAC ft model (orange bars) and the SESHA ft model (green bars). The vertical axis lists the optimizations applied—Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates—while the horizontal axis represents the "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large," with values ranging from 0.000 to 0.003. For each optimization, the chart compares the performance of the two models. The NESAC ft model consistently shows a higher WER difference than the SESHA ft model across all optimizations. The highest WER difference for the NESAC ft model is observed with the "Normalised" optimization (0.00334), while the lowest is with the "Dates" optimization (0.00257). For the SESHA ft model, the highest WER difference is with the "Add Spacing" optimization (0.00344), and the lowest is with the "Dates" optimization (0.00228). The chart indicates that the SESHA ft model generally performs better (lower WER difference) than the NESAC ft model for all tested optimizations.
